issues.passage: From the rear of the auditorium, she had a clear anterior view of the stage.
issues.why: Anterior view = view of the front aspect. From the rear of the auditorium she is looking at the stage’s front (audience-facing) side, so this is valid spatial use of anterior, not a misuse. Position “from the rear” does not cancel “anterior view of the stage.”

fix.correctPassage: The surgeon marked the incision along the anterior surface of the thigh.
wrongPassages: She chose an anterior seat against the back wall so she could slip out unnoticed.
The sequel, released years later, was described as anterior to the original film.
The revised conclusion, written last, was labeled the anterior section of the paper.
